title: Different Learning Methods of Motor Control Exercises
brief_summary: This study evaluates the effects of self-learning exercise from multimedia content on pain and disability in patients with low back pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic (\>3 month), non-specific low back pain
* 25- 55 years old
* Have a capacity can understand exercise instructions (Montreal Cognitive Assessment \> 21)
* Being a computer literate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Root nerve signs
* Cauda equina syndrome
* Fracture in the vertebra
* Tumour
* Have a neurologic disease
* History of spine surgery
* Knowing motor control exercises
* Visual impairment
* Hearing loss
